# Theme 6: Applied ML Research {.unnumbered}

A model is only useful when others understand what you did, and research often has a better approach than the one you would come up with yourself. In this theme you learn to present and write about technical work, to find and read machine-learning research, and to test an idea from a paper yourself.

## Activities

Work through the activities in order:

1. [Communicating Technical Work](09_communicating_technical_work.qmd), about 4 hours: a lecture on presenting and one on writing, and your own checklists for both.
2. [Understanding ML Research](10_understanding_ml_research.qmd), about 2 hours: types of research output, the scientific method, research metrics, and how to find and access papers.
3. [Research to Practice](11_from_research_to_practice.qmd), about 6 hours: read a machine-learning paper and test one of its principles in a project of your own.

This is the last theme of the Self-study.
